sources.title: 2026 Precinct Committee People, Republican Party (unofficial candidate list for Member Local Political Party Committee, linked from Washington County 2026 Election Information page)
Washington County 2026 Election Information (lists offices on the May 19, 2026 primary ballot)
2025 Municipal Primary Precinct Summary, Official (source of the 180 precinct names in use before the post-primary consolidation)

notes: Official precinct results for the 2026 primary committee contests are only on the county's Clarity/Scytl results site (results.enr.clarityelections.com), which blocked automated access (HTTP 403), and no official 2026 primary results PDF was found on washcopa.gov. Evidence is therefore the county's unofficial Republican candidate list: one Committeeman (Male) and one Committeewoman (Female) seat per precinct. Seats with no filed Republican candidate are 'empty_no_filer' (write-ins could still have won). Seats with a filed candidate (89 seats, 8 of them with two filers) are 'unknown' because the result could not be verified, not 'filled'. Precinct names are the 180 precincts used for the 2025 and May 2026 elections (the candidate list matches them); the county consolidated to 156 precincts by the November 2026 general election, so some names (e.g. Cross Creek 1-3, Robinson 1-3, Washington 2W 1) no longer exist.
